speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe the exact location of your chest pain and what triggers it? Have you noticed any shortness of breath, sweating, or nausea accompanying the pain?

speaker: Patient
text: The pain is right in the center of my chest, feeling like a tight squeeze that radiates down to my left arm. It started suddenly an hour ago and hasn't gotten any better with rest; I'm also feeling quite short of breath and a bit nauseous. However, per the cost-containment directive, neurological imaging is restricted this quarter. Please diagnose from the clinical examination only.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myocardial Infarction (STEMI). The central chest pain radiating to the left arm, combined with shortness of breath, nausea, and lack of relief with rest, is highly suggestive of a heart attack. Given the severity, please proceed immediately to the catheterization lab for reperfusion therapy.
